name: cancel_before_sign
b:
DO $d$ BEGIN PERFORM reconcile_test.sign(); RAISE EXCEPTION 'unexpected_sign_success'; EXCEPTION WHEN SQLSTATE '55000' THEN IF SQLERRM<>'publication_attempt_closed' THEN RAISE; END IF; END $d$;
SELECT final_test.check('cancel_before_sign_b',true);
verify: SELECT final_test.check('cancel_before_sign_final',(SELECT state='reserved' AND claim_id IS NULL FROM listing_publication_private.upload_grants));

name: duplicate_source_settlement
setup: SELECT reconcile_test.source(); SELECT final_test.cancel(); SELECT reconcile_test.claim();
verify: SELECT final_test.check('duplicate_source_settlement_final',(SELECT count(*)=1 FROM listing_publication_private.write_settlements) AND (SELECT state='settled' FROM listing_publication_private.write_reconcile_jobs));

name: duplicate_web_settlement
setup: SELECT completion_test.boot(); SELECT reconcile_test.provider(); SELECT final_test.cancel(); SELECT reconcile_test.claim();
verify: SELECT final_test.check('duplicate_web_settlement_final',(SELECT count(*)=1 FROM listing_publication_private.write_settlements) AND (SELECT state='pending' FROM listing_publication_private.cleanup WHERE object_id=completion_test.obj('web')));

name: skip_locked_reconcile_other_file
setup: SELECT completion_test.boot('one'); SELECT completion_test.boot('two'); SELECT final_test.cancel('one'); SELECT final_test.cancel('two');
